description_blocks.text: Controlled Cutting for Everyday Maker Tasks

After printing, small cutting tasks still remain—trimming printed edges, cleaning up thin material, or preparing tape and other bench-side materials for assembly and finishing. The Precision Cutter delivers clean, controlled cuts for these everyday maker tasks, helping you work more accurately throughout your workflow.
Stable Blade Lock for Precise Cuts

A dual-locking structure combines an axial lock with an anti-shake clip to keep the blade firmly in place during use. This stable construction reduces blade wobble during detailed cutting, giving you better control when trimming small parts, thin materials, or model details.
Sharp 30° Blade for Fine Work

The slim 30° high-carbon steel blade is designed for detailed cutting and precise trimming. Its fine tip makes it easier to work on narrow areas, clean edges, and other tasks that require more precision than standard utility knives can provide.
Two Kits for Different Workbench Needs

The Maker's Supply Precision Cutter Line is designed for superior control and durability, featuring ergonomic handles and ultra-sharp, replaceable 30° blades. Whether you're a hobbyist or a professional, our range provides the right tool for clean, precise cutting in your projects. The Precision Cutter is available in two configurations to match different maker workflows.
Precision Cutter Starter Kit includes a plastic cutter and 10 PCS/Set blades: Lightweight and practical, it is a great choice for everyday cutting tasks and first-time workspace setup.

Professional Metallic Cutter Set includes a metallic cutter and 10 PCS/Set blades: The metal body provides a more solid in-hand feel and improved stability, making it better suited for frequent use and more demanding precision work. * Each cutter includes 1 pre-installed blade. For the best value and added convenience, choose the cutter set, which includes 10 PCS replacement blades.
* Each cutter includes 1 pre-installed blade. For the best value and added convenience, choose the cutter set, which includes 10 PCS replacement blades.
Usage Instructions
Step 1: Press the locking button and slide it forward.
Step 2: Open the blade compartment.
Step 3: Remove the old blade.
Step 4: Insert a new blade and close the compartment firmly.
Considerations
Before applying significant force, always ensure the automatic lock is securely engaged.
Inspect the blade regularly. Replace it immediately if you notice any cracks, chips, or significant dullness.
Please avoid using this cutter on hard materials such as metal, ceramic, or stone to prevent damage to the tool and potential safety hazards.
